# Codex 0.166.0 hook trust probe

Captured from the installed CLI on 2026-11-06, using an isolated temporary
CODEX_HOME, seven hooks generated by CodexLauncher, and JSON-RPC initialize /
hooks/list. No model request and no changes to the user configuration.

The first response lists the definitions before trust; the second repeats the
same flags with per-key hooks.state hashes returned by that installed CLI.
Temporary command paths are retained verbatim. These fixtures contain no token.
Do not hand-edit captured replies.
